id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|874c: "Some years ago I even traveled to holy Arboria to buy old books. It was hard, but now it's a fond memory.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|897c: "Some years ago I even traveled to holy Arboria to buy old books. It was hard, but now it's a fond memory.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8c00: "Some years ago I even traveled to holy Arboria to buy old books. It was hard, but now it's a fond memory.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|906c: "Some years ago I even traveled to holy Arboria to buy old books. It was hard, but now it's a fond memory.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|94d8: "Some years ago I even traveled to holy Arboria to buy old books. It was hard, but now it's a fond memory.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8cec: "...What became of the old books from then? Oh, I gave them to a woodcutter who came to Gallopolis, so they aren't here.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9158: "...What became of the old books from then? Oh, I gave them to a woodcutter who came to Gallopolis, so they aren't here.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|95c4: "...What became of the old books from then? Oh, I gave them to a woodcutter who came to Gallopolis, so they aren't here.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8da4: "He liked the book so much and insisted, so I had no choice...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9210: "He liked the book so much and insisted, so I had no choice...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|967c: "He liked the book so much and insisted, so I had no choice...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8e24: "He said he lives in a cabin in Manglegrove, but I wonder how he's doing now...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9290: "He said he lives in a cabin in Manglegrove, but I wonder how he's doing now...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|96fc: "He said he lives in a cabin in Manglegrove, but I wonder how he's doing now...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|98fc: "Hmm, I can't settle on the composition. I want a jolt, you know... In short, a painting needs a jolt.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|99e4: "You see, I'm a painter. To paint with a jolt, you need imagination. That's why I'm just standing here.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9ac4: "Thanks to standing here, I found my theme. I want to paint beasts frolicking under the moon...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9bac: "But somehow, it doesn't quite jolt me. I think something fatal is missing.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9d30: "If you used the Pep Power Wild Side to beat the spitzfire at the Celestial Sands Stones at night, it would definitely jolt me.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9e0c: "What do you say? Will you do it?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9eb4: "Hmm, I see. What a shame... It would surely have jolted me. But if you can't, you can't...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a014: "Good, good answer. That answer jolted me a bit too...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a08c: "Right, about Wild Side. It's a Pep Power you can use when three specific people are together.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a138: "To learn who needs to be in the Pep to use it, select Stats and press the A Button to check the Pep Powers.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a490: "To learn who needs to be in the Pep to use it, select Stats and press the A Button to check the Pep Powers.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a1f8: "Then, for a jolting impact... I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a550: "Then, for a jolting impact... I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a30c: "At night, in the Celestial Sands Stones of the Gallopolis region, I want you to beat the spitzfire using the Pep Power Wild Side.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a3d8: "About the Pep Power Wild Side: it's one you can use when three specific people are together.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a69c: "It hit me. It jolted me... I watched your battle from afar the whole time...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a744: "Thanks to you it's decided. The painting's title: Dance Under the Moon, Waltz of Beasts... Wild Side of You, Her, and Me...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a808: "Hmm, it hit me... Now I'll think of nothing. Paint without thinking. That's all there is.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a8c8: "To thank you for the jolt, I'll give you this.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a930: "That jolt is a first in a long time... Being present at moments like this is why an artist can't quit.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aa64: "Dance Under the Moon, Waltz of Beasts... Wild Side of You, Her, and Me...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aaec: "Hmm, a jolting title. Now I'll think of nothing. Paint without thinking. That's all there is.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|abb0: "By the way, do you know Erdwin's Lantern? That also jolts me. Next time I want to paint it as a subject.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19d9: "It's a building from a very ancient time... But who built it and for what purpose, it's all wrapped in mystery.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23e8: "I'm Hakim, the gatekeeper here. Traveler, if you're heading to Gondolia, please hear me out.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23f8: "I have a younger sister named Akia who works as a pâtissier at a cake shop in Gondolia...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2403: "She seems busy lately and doesn't show her face, so I wrote a letter.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|240e: "...So I have a favor. Since I can't leave here, could you deliver this letter to my sister Akia?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2425: "I see... asking such a thing of a stranger was presumptuous. Sorry, forget it.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|243c: "Oh, you'll do it! Listening to a stranger's request, you're kind.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2448: "Then take this letter. You know it's important, so please don't lose it.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2455: {var:1} received a letter from the older brother!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|245b: "Akia should be working at the cake shop in the northwest of Gondolia. Now, I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2478: "Akia should be working at the cake shop in the northwest of Gondolia. Now, I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|246d: "Please deliver the letter I gave you to my sister Akia in Gondolia.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|248a: "Oh, traveler, you're back. So how was my sister? Is she doing well?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2496: Give Hakim the letter from Akia?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24bc: "Oh, this is a letter from Akia! You came all this way to deliver it, thank you! Let me read it now. Let's see...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24c7: ...Brother, I got your letter. I work hard every day. The money you sent must have been hard on you... thank you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24d5: Thanks to you always cheering me on, I can focus on my pâtissier training. Yesterday the master praised my talent again.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24e3: To become a full-fledged pâtissier, I'll keep chasing my dream. So don't worry, brother... From Akia.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24f0: "...Heh, she's working hard. Glad she seems well.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24f6: "Actually, we siblings have a worthless father. We don't live together now...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2530: "Actually, we siblings have a worthless father. We don't live together now...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2503: "After he injured his leg once, he turned wild. He was the worst kind of father, taking it out even on his children.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|253c: "After he injured his leg once, he turned wild. He was the worst kind of father, taking it out even on his children.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2511: "We two endured that childhood together, so I want Akia to do what she loves.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|254a: "We two endured that childhood together, so I want Akia to do what she loves.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|251c: "Anyway, I'm relieved to know she's well. Here, this is my thanks. Take it.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2556: "Thanks to you I know how my sister is doing and I'm relieved. Thank you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2580: "I studied astronomy, but Erdwin's Lantern, my research subject, vanished from the night sky and I lost all drive.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2593: "But when a fellow scholar showed me a giant star shard brought back from the desert, something surged in my brain!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|259f: "I need a new giant star shard for my research, but monsters fill the area where they fall. Too dangerous!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25b1: "Please, traveler. Won't you get a giant star shard in my place?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25c5: "Ugh... come to think of it, asking a stranger such a selfish favor out of the blue, I was a bit desperate.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25da: "That's a great help. According to fellow scholars, giant star shards often fall in the desert north of Gallopolis.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25e5: "When you get a giant star shard, please come back here. Now, I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2607: "When you get a giant star shard, please come back here. Now, I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25f6: "To study Erdwin's Lantern's fallen fragments, please fetch a giant star shard from the desert north of Gallopolis.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2618: "Now isn't the time to compile hypotheses... I must examine the giant star shard again to support my conjecture...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2628: "Oh, I didn't notice. Traveler, could you have gotten a giant star shard?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2636: "Oh, I see. Sorry, I got my hopes up and jumped the gun.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2652: "Oh! Thank you! Now then, let me examine this giant star shard.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|265d: "I see! This giant star shard bears traces of the sealing patterns used by ancient people!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|266a: "Since it was called a lantern of the Luminary, the Luminary's great power must have been sealed in that star!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26b6: "Since it was called a lantern of the Luminary, the Luminary's great power must have been sealed in that star!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2678: "The shard's carved phrase bothers me: "entrusted to those of the distant future." Is the Luminary's power left to the future?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26c4: "The shard's carved phrase bothers me: "entrusted to those of the distant future." Is the Luminary's power left to the future?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2689: "Hmm... I'm getting more and more eager to research this!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|268e: "Traveler, the giant star shard you got is truly fascinating! Please accept my thanks.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26a9: "Thanks to you, I learned the giant star shard bears traces of the sealing patterns used by ancient people.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26d5: "Hmm... researching the giant star shard is quite tough. This may become my life's work!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|292a: "Then word of the circus will spread across the world, and people darkened by the Dark One might think the same.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|297a: "Then word of the circus will spread across the world, and people darkened by the Dark One might think the same.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2924: "We'll keep livening up Gallopolis with the circus.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2973: "We'll keep livening up Gallopolis with the circus.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|349c: "What, you don't get it. Did you properly watch the prince's fight against the desert killer?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34a8: "With that brave fighting, he must be fast on a horse! No way he'd lose to a Faiz!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44a7: "Oh, you're the prince's friends. Welcome. Please do meet the prince.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4636: "The Faris Cup was surprising. That Sylvando who joined on a whim did so well.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5489: "I'm so glad the prince returned safely without injury. His courage against that monster was splendid too.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|54a7: "I'm so glad the prince returned safely without injury. His courage against that monster was splendid too.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7a47: "Hey, I was waiting for you! As my benefactor, I have something I'd like to ask of you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7a54: "It's embarrassing, but since the black sun appeared, monsters have grown violent and our soldiers are swamped.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7a65: "Maybe from lack of real combat, they lack focus and fall at crucial moments. Like this, defending the country is impossible.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7a75: "So I looked into it... and there is an item favored by ancient warriors to boost focus in battle!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7a86: "Its name is the Zonnal branch! That's enough to understand, right? I'll pay, so get me a Zonnal branch?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7a9f: "I-I see. Can't be helped... I'll think of another way for now, but if you change your mind, talk to me again.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ab8: "I knew you'd say so, my dear friend! Given where the Zonnal tree grows, I have no choice but to rely on your kindness.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7aca: "...The Zonnal tree grows on the plateau called the North Heights in the First Forest. I want a branch of that tree.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b13: "...The Zonnal tree grows on the plateau called the North Heights in the First Forest. I want a branch of that tree.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ada: "I hear that place is like forbidden ground, closed to all but special people, but I believe you can manage.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7aea: "...Then I'm counting on you. Gallopolis's bright future rests on your shoulders!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b02: "Our soldiers lack focus. I want the Zonnal branch the ancient warriors used.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b24: "I hear that place is like forbidden ground, closed to all but special people, but you can manage it, can't you?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b32: "Gallopolis's bright future rests on your shoulders. I'm counting on you, {var:1}.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b44: "Welcome back, {var:1}! Did you get the Zonnal branch from the First Forest?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b52: "...Please, I'm counting on you. For Gallopolis's soldiers, we absolutely need the Zonnal branch.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b71: "So this is the Zonnal branch... Actually, what I need is the nuts on the branch. These are the legendary miracle fruit!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b80: "They say biting a miracle fruit clears the mind, boosts focus, and instantly puts you in the Pep state.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b90: "But one or two miracle fruit won't help our soldiers. We must somehow increase their number.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b9e: "That's why I had you bring the whole branch. If we graft this Zonnal branch and multiply it, someday every soldier gets fruit.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7baf: "It's all thanks to you. As thanks, please take the miracle fruit that was on the branch.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7bc4: "Miracle fruit is a wonderful fruit that boosts focus in battle. It will surely help in your fights ahead.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7bd3: "As for cultivating miracle fruit, I'll invite botanists from around the world to Gallopolis and proceed carefully.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7be3: "...Because if we fail, you'd have to go to the First Forest again.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7c11: "Oh... sir, could you want Gallopolis's famous cactus steak?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7c1a: "If so, sorry. We've paused cactus steak for now to research a new flavor.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7c3e: "Please! For a new cactus steak, defeat a golden globe and get a golden cactus!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7c53: "Ha ha! Right. It's troublesome to be asked out of the blue. Sorry, forget it.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7c5d: "Well, can't be helped... I'll try again to improve cactus steak made with ordinary ingredients.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7c76: "Really?! Oh, that helps! Because of people like you, the world's cooking can advance.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7c82: "The golden globe that drops the golden cactus is a rare reborn monster near Gallopolis's southwest campsite.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7cd9: "The golden globe that drops the golden cactus is a rare reborn monster near Gallopolis's southwest campsite.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7c90: "It's rare to see, but fight cactiballs around the southwest campsite and you'll surely meet one.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ce8: "It's rare to see, but fight cactiballs around the southwest campsite and you'll surely meet one.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7cb5: "One golden cactus is enough, plenty for a trial. When you get it, bring it to me.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d0c: "One golden cactus is enough, plenty for a trial. When you get it, bring it to me.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ccc: "I'm not satisfied with the cactus steak's flavor and want to reach the next rank. For that I need a golden cactus.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d1c: "Oh, a customer. You came to my place, so did you get the golden cactus?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d29: "Oh dear, is that so. A bit of a letdown.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d2e: "But fine. Either way, you're my only hope now. I'll wait as long as it takes.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d47: "Th-this is the golden cactus! Amazing, the shine is different from regular cacti! Thick too, it looks satisfying to eat!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d52: "First, a bite raw... Mm-hm, this stringy stickiness and this tongue-stinging tartness are superb!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d5e: "Good, good. With this, I can make the ultimate cactus steak just as I imagined!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d71: "There are other reborn monsters like the golden globe. Gather sightings and look for them while gaining battle experience!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7da0: "There are other reborn monsters like the golden globe. Gather sightings and look for them while gaining battle experience!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d89: "Hey, customer! Thanks to you I'm working hard every day to improve the cactus steak flavor!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d93: "Still, it's not the flavor I was after yet. When it's done, I'll ask you to taste test.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7dd0: "I'm Zaius, just a humble horse keeper.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e02: "I'm Zaius, just a humble horse keeper.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e34: "I'm Zaius, just a humble horse keeper.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e67: "I'm Zaius, just a humble horse keeper.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7dd6: "Truth is, I used to be a race jockey, but I fell in the biggest race and hurt my leg...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e08: "Truth is, I used to be a race jockey, but I fell in the biggest race and hurt my leg...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e3a: "Truth is, I used to be a race jockey, but I fell in the biggest race and hurt my leg...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7dee: "Now, when you're done talking, step aside. I can't get fired for being caught slacking.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e20: "Now, when you're done talking, step aside. I can't get fired for being caught slacking.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e52: "Now, when you're done talking, step aside. I can't get fired for being caught slacking.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e6d: "...What is it, traveler? Is something on my face? Don't stare so much.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e78: "Sorry, but I'm very busy with work... I have to work harder for my kids.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e83: "To support their dreams, I have to save lots of money. So I've no time to rest.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e94: "I was a truly terrible father. I worked like mad to make up to my kids even a little...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ea1: "And to a hopeless man like me, my children came to visit! This isn't a dream, is it?!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ead: "I hear living as a family again is all thanks to you, traveler! You're my god, thank you!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ece: "Ah, mail carrier with the clear eyes! I was worried about the world turning out like this! Glad you're well...!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7eda: "At times like this, we three decided to live huddled together as a family. Having family nearby is reassuring.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ef0: "Oh, you're the traveler from that time. Thank you for helping my sister and me.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7f08: "...But Dad's back, seen after so long, had grown so small... I realized you can't stay a child forever.

tm.「この家の 奥さまは 古い書物の収集が趣味で\n 召使いである わたくしも その: "The lady of this house collects old books as a hobby, and I, her servant, get dragged along in many ways.
tm.「何年か前は 遠く 聖地ラムダにまで\n 古書を 買い集めにいったものです。\n: "Some years ago I even traveled to holy Arboria to buy old books. It was hard, but now it's a fond memory.
tm.「……えっ その時の古書が どうなったかって？\n ああ それなら サマディーに: "...What became of the old books from then? Oh, I gave them to a woodcutter who came to Gallopolis, so they aren't here.
tm.「その本を たいそう 気に入って\n どうしてもと言うので 仕方なくね……。: "He liked the book so much and insisted, so I had no choice...
tm.「彼は ナプガーナ密林にある\n 小屋に住んでいると 言っていましたが\n 今は: "He said he lives in a cabin in Manglegrove, but I wonder how he's doing now...
tm.「うーん 画の構図がね なかなか決まらないね。\n こう ガッと来るようなね 衝: "Hmm, I can't settle on the composition. I want a jolt, you know... In short, a painting needs a jolt.
tm.「あのねえ ボクはね 画家なんだねえ。\n ガッと来る画を描くには 空想が必要だ: "You see, I'm a painter. To paint with a jolt, you need imagination. That's why I'm just standing here.
tm.「突っ立ってたおかげで テーマも決まってね。\n 月の下で暴れる 獣たちの競演を: "Thanks to standing here, I found my theme. I want to paint beasts frolicking under the moon...
tm.「なんかねえ いまいち ガッと来ないんだね。\n ボクが思うにね 致命的に\n: "But somehow, it doesn't quite jolt me. I think something fatal is missing.
tm.「キミが れんけい技 ビーストモードを使って\n 夜に バクラバ石群の ワイバー: "If you used the Pep Power Wild Side to beat the spitzfire at the Celestial Sands Stones at night, it would definitely jolt me.
tm.「どうかねえ やってくれるかねえ？: "What do you say? Will you do it?
tm.「うーん なるほどね。それは 残念だねえ……。\n 間違いなく ガッと来そうなん: "Hmm, I see. What a shame... It would surely have jolted me. But if you can't, you can't...
tm.「いいね いい返事だねえ。\n 今の返事も なかなか ガッと来たね……。: "Good, good answer. That answer jolted me a bit too...
tm.「そうそう ビーストモードだけどねえ。\n 特定の３人が そろっていれば\n 繰: "Right, about Wild Side. It's a Pep Power you can use when three specific people are together.
tm.「誰が ゾーンになれば使えるのか 知りたい時は\n つよさを選んで Ａボタンを押: "To learn who needs to be in the Pep to use it, select Stats and press the A Button to check the Pep Powers.
tm.「それじゃ ガッと来るような衝撃のために……\n ひとつ よろしく頼むねえ。: "Then, for a jolting impact... I'm counting on you.
tm.「夜に サマディー地方の バクラバ石群にいる\n ワイバーンドッグを れんけい技: "At night, in the Celestial Sands Stones of the Gallopolis region, I want you to beat the spitzfire using the Pep Power Wild Side.
tm.「れんけい技の ビーストモードだけどねえ\n 特定の３人が そろっていれば\n: "About the Pep Power Wild Side: it's one you can use when three specific people are together.
tm.「来たねえ ガッと来ちゃったねえ……。\n ボクね キミたちの戦いをねえ\n 遠: "It hit me. It jolted me... I watched your battle from afar the whole time...
tm.「おかげで決まったね。画のタイトルはだね\n 月下乱舞 獣たちのワルツ……\n: "Thanks to you it's decided. The painting's title: Dance Under the Moon, Waltz of Beasts... Wild Side of You, Her, and Me...
tm.「うーん 来ちゃったねえ……。\n もう こうなったら 何も考えないね。\n 何: "Hmm, it hit me... Now I'll think of nothing. Paint without thinking. That's all there is.
tm.「ガッと来ちゃった お礼にねえ\n キミに これを渡しちゃうんだねえ。: "To thank you for the jolt, I'll give you this.
tm.「このガッと来た衝撃は ひさびさだね……。\n こういった瞬間に 立ち会えちゃう: "That jolt is a first in a long time... Being present at moments like this is why an artist can't quit.
tm.「月下乱舞 獣たちのワルツ……\n キミと彼女と私の ビーストモード……。: "Dance Under the Moon, Waltz of Beasts... Wild Side of You, Her, and Me...
tm.「うーん ガッと来るタイトルだね。\n もう こうなったら 何も考えないね。\n: "Hmm, a jolting title. Now I'll think of nothing. Paint without thinking. That's all there is.
tm.「ところで キミは 勇者の星を知ってるかね？\n あれも なかなか ガッと来るん: "By the way, do you know Erdwin's Lantern? That also jolts me. Next time I want to paint it as a subject.
tm.「とても古い時代の 建造物なのですが……。\n 一体 誰が どんな目的で作ったの: "It's a building from a very ancient time... But who built it and for what purpose, it's all wrapped in mystery.
tm.「私は アポロ。ここで 門番をしている者だ。\n 旅の方よ……ダーハルーネの町に: "I'm Hakim, the gatekeeper here. Traveler, if you're heading to Gondolia, please hear me out.
tm.「私には ディアナという 妹がいてな。\n ダーハルーネにある ケーキ屋で\n: "I have a younger sister named Akia who works as a pâtissier at a cake shop in Gondolia...
tm.「近頃は 忙しくしているようで\n カオも見せに来ないから\n こうして 手紙を: "She seems busy lately and doesn't show her face, so I wrote a letter.
tm.「……そこで 旅の方に 頼みがある。\n ここを離れられない 私の代わりに\n: "...So I have a favor. Since I can't leave here, could you deliver this letter to my sister Akia?
tm.「そうだな……見ず知らずの旅の方に\n こんな頼みごとして ずうずうしかったな。: "I see... asking such a thing of a stranger was presumptuous. Sorry, forget it.
tm.「おお 引き受けてくれるのか！\n 見ず知らずの 私の頼みを聞いてくれるなんて\: "Oh, you'll do it! Listening to a stranger's request, you're kind.
tm.「では この手紙を受け取ってくれ。\n わかってると思うが 大事な手紙だから\n: "Then take this letter. You know it's important, so please don't lose it.
tm.{var:1}は\n兄からの手紙を 受け取った！: {var:1} received a letter from the older brother!
tm.「ディアナは ダーハルーネの町の中の\n 北西にあるケーキ屋で はたらいているは: "Akia should be working at the cake shop in the northwest of Gondolia. Now, I'm counting on you.
tm.「キミに渡した その手紙を\n ダーハルーネの町にいる\n 私の妹 ディアナに届: "Please deliver the letter I gave you to my sister Akia in Gondolia.
tm.「おお 旅の方よ 戻ってきたか。\n それで 妹の様子は どうだった？\n あい: "Oh, traveler, you're back. So how was my sister? Is she doing well?
tm.アポロに ディアナから預かった\n手紙を渡しますか？: Give Hakim the letter from Akia?
tm.「おお これは ディアナからの手紙！\n わざわざ 届けにきてくれたのか ありが: "Oh, this is a letter from Akia! You came all this way to deliver it, thank you! Let me read it now. Let's see...
tm.……兄さん お手紙 受け取ったわ。\n私は 毎日 元気に はたらいてます。\n仕: ...Brother, I got your letter. I work hard every day. The money you sent must have been hard on you... thank you.
tm.兄さんが いつも応援してくれるおかげで\n私も パティシエの修行に 専念できるわ: Thanks to you always cheering me on, I can focus on my pâtissier training. Yesterday the master praised my talent again.

tm.「じつはな 私たち兄妹には\n ろくでもない父親がいるんだ。\n 今はもう 一緒: "Actually, we siblings have a worthless father. We don't live together now...
tm.「ある時 足をケガしてから 荒れてしまってな。\n 子供にまで 八つ当たりをする: "After he injured his leg once, he turned wild. He was the worst kind of father, taking it out even on his children.
tm.「そんな幼少時代を 兄妹ふたりで\n ずっと 耐えてきたから……ディアナには\n: "We two endured that childhood together, so I want Akia to do what she loves.
tm.「とにかく 元気だとわかって安心したよ。\n さあ これは お礼だ。受け取ってく: "Anyway, I'm relieved to know she's well. Here, this is my thanks. Take it.
tm.「キミのおかげで 妹の近況がわかって\n 安心したよ ありがとう。: "Thanks to you I know how my sister is doing and I'm relieved. Thank you.
tm.「私は天文学を 研究していたのですが……\n 研究対象だった 勇者の星が 夜空か: "I studied astronomy, but Erdwin's Lantern, my research subject, vanished from the night sky and I lost all drive.
tm.「しかし 学者仲間が 砂漠から\n 持ちかえってきた 巨星のカケラを見たとき\n: "But when a fellow scholar showed me a giant star shard brought back from the desert, something surged in my brain!
tm.「研究を進めるため 新たに 巨星のカケラが\n 欲しいのですが カケラの落ちてい: "I need a new giant star shard for my research, but monsters fill the area where they fall. Too dangerous!
tm.「お願いです 旅の人。\n どうか 私の代わりに 巨星のカケラを\n 手に入れて: "Please, traveler. Won't you get a giant star shard in my place?
tm.「うぐっ……考えてみれば 見ず知らずの人に\n いきなり こんな勝手な頼みをする: "Ugh... come to think of it, asking a stranger such a selfish favor out of the blue, I was a bit desperate.
tm.「それは ありがたい。\n 学者仲間によれば 巨星のカケラは\n サマディー北の: "That's a great help. According to fellow scholars, giant star shards often fall in the desert north of Gallopolis.
tm.「巨星のカケラが 手に入ったら\n ここに 戻ってきてください。\n それでは: "When you get a giant star shard, please come back here. Now, I'm counting on you.

tm.「今は 仮説を まとめる段階ではない……。\n もう一度 巨星のカケラを 調べて: "Now isn't the time to compile hypotheses... I must examine the giant star shard again to support my conjecture...

tm.「おっと そうですか。\n すみません ちょっと期待しすぎて\n 早とちりしてし: "Oh, I see. Sorry, I got my hopes up and jumped the gun.
tm.「おおっ！ ありがとうございます！\n では さっそく この巨星のカケラを\n: "Oh! Thank you! Now then, let me examine this giant star shard.

tm.「勇者の星と呼ばれていたくらいですし\n あの星には 勇者さまの 大いなるチカラ: "Since it was called a lantern of the Luminary, the Luminary's great power must have been sealed in that star!
tm.「しかし 気になるのは カケラに刻まれた\n 遠き未来の者たちに託す……と読める: "The shard's carved phrase bothers me: "entrusted to those of the distant future." Is the Luminary's power left to the future?
tm.「ううむ……これは もっともっと\n 研究してみたくなってきたぞ！: "Hmm... I'm getting more and more eager to research this!
tm.「旅の人よ あなたが手に入れてくれた\n 巨星のカケラは じつに興味深い物です！: "Traveler, the giant star shard you got is truly fascinating! Please accept my thanks.
tm.「あなたのおかげで 巨星のカケラには\n 古代の人たちが使っていたという\n 封: "Thanks to you, I learned the giant star shard bears traces of the sealing patterns used by ancient people.
tm.「ううむ……巨星のカケラの研究は\n なかなか大変で ひと筋縄ではいきませんね。: "Hmm... researching the giant star shard is quite tough. This may become my life's work!
tm.「そしたら サーカスのウワサが 世界に広まって\n 魔王のせいで 暗くなっている: "Then word of the circus will spread across the world, and people darkened by the Dark One might think the same.

tm.「王子さまが ケガもせず 無事に帰ってきて\n 本当に よかったわい。\n あの: "I'm so glad the prince returned safely without injury. His courage against that monster was splendid too.
tm.「やあ キミのことを 待っていたんだよ！\n ボクの恩人である キミのことを見込: "Hey, I was waiting for you! As my benefactor, I have something I'd like to ask of you.
tm.「情けない話だけど 黒い太陽が\n 現れてからというもの 魔物が凶暴化して\n: "It's embarrassing, but since the black sun appeared, monsters have grown violent and our soldiers are swamped.
tm.「実戦経験が少ないせいか 集中力が足りなくて\n ここぞってときに やられちゃう: "Maybe from lack of real combat, they lack focus and fall at crucial moments. Like this, defending the country is impossible.
tm.「なんとかしようと いろいろ調べてみたら……\n あるじゃないか 戦闘中に 集中: "So I looked into it... and there is an item favored by ancient warriors to boost focus in battle!
tm.「その名は ゾンナルの樹の枝！ ここまで言えば\n わかってくれるよね？ 報酬は: "Its name is the Zonnal branch! That's enough to understand, right? I'll pay, so get me a Zonnal branch?

tm.「その場所は 特別な者以外は入れない\n 禁足地のようなものだと 聞いているけど: "I hear that place is like forbidden ground, closed to all but special people, but I believe you can manage.
tm.「……それじゃあ よろしく頼むよ。\n 我がサマディー王国の 明るい未来は\n: "...Then I'm counting on you. Gallopolis's bright future rests on your shoulders!
tm.「我が国の兵士たちは 集中力が足りなくてね。\n いにしえの戦士が 使っていたと: "Our soldiers lack focus. I want the Zonnal branch the ancient warriors used.
tm.「その場所は 特別な者以外は入れない\n 禁足地のようなものだと 聞いているけど: "I hear that place is like forbidden ground, closed to all but special people, but you can manage it, can't you?
tm.「我がサマディー王国の 明るい未来は\n キミの両肩に かかっているからね。\n: "Gallopolis's bright future rests on your shoulders. I'm counting on you, {var:1}.
tm.「おかえり {var:1}！\n もしかして 始祖の森から\n ゾンナルの樹の枝: "Welcome back, {var:1}! Did you get the Zonnal branch from the First Forest?
tm.「……くれぐれも よろしく頼むよ。\n サマディー王国の兵士たちのためには\n: "...Please, I'm counting on you. For Gallopolis's soldiers, we absolutely need the Zonnal branch.
tm.「これが ゾンナルの樹の枝……じつはね\n 必要なのは 枝に実った 木の実のほう: "So this is the Zonnal branch... Actually, what I need is the nuts on the branch. These are the legendary miracle fruit!
tm.「この きせきのきのみを かじってみれば\n 意識はハッキリして 集中力は増し\: "They say biting a miracle fruit clears the mind, boosts focus, and instantly puts you in the Pep state.

tm.「そのために 枝ごと 持ってきてもらったのさ。\n このゾンナルの樹の枝を接ぎ木: "That's why I had you bring the whole branch. If we graft this Zonnal branch and multiply it, someday every soldier gets fruit.
tm.「全部 キミのおかげだよ。\n ありがとう お礼として 枝についていた\n きせ: "It's all thanks to you. As thanks, please take the miracle fruit that was on the branch.

tm.「きせきのきのみを 栽培する件は\n 世界各地の植物学者を サマディーに招いて\: "As for cultivating miracle fruit, I'll invite botanists from around the world to Gallopolis and proceed carefully.
tm.「……だってほら 失敗しちゃったら\n また キミに 始祖の森まで\n 行っても: "...Because if we fail, you'd have to go to the First Forest again.
tm.「おっと……！\n お客さん もしかして サマディー名物\n サボテンステーキを: "Oh... sir, could you want Gallopolis's famous cactus steak?
tm.「だったら すまないね。\n 今は ちょっと サボテンステーキは\n お休みして: "If so, sorry. We've paused cactus steak for now to research a new flavor.
tm.「頼む！ 新しいサボテンステーキのため\n サボテンゴールドを倒し ゴールドサボ: "Please! For a new cactus steak, defeat a golden globe and get a golden cactus!

tm.「まぁ しょうがない……。\n もう一度 普通の材料で作る\n サボテンステーキ: "Well, can't be helped... I'll try again to improve cactus steak made with ordinary ingredients.

tm.「ゴールドサボテンを落とす サボテンゴールドは\n サマディー王国の 南西のキャ: "The golden globe that drops the golden cactus is a rare reborn monster near Gallopolis's southwest campsite.

tm.「こ……これが ゴールドサボテンか！\n すごいな 普通のサボテンとは ツヤが違: "Th-this is the golden cactus! Amazing, the shine is different from regular cacti! Thick too, it looks satisfying to eat!
tm.「とりあえず 生で ひとクチ……。\n ふむふむ この糸引くような ねばり気も\: "First, a bite raw... Mm-hm, this stringy stickiness and this tongue-stinging tartness are superb!

tm.「やあ お客さん！\n おかげさんで サボテンステーキの味の改良に\n こっちは: "Hey, customer! Thanks to you I'm working hard every day to improve the cactus steak flavor!
